These gzip NBT fixtures are independently hand-encoded from vanilla 26.3
MapItemSavedData.CODEC, MapIndex.CODEC, MapBanner.CODEC and MapFrame.CODEC.
They were not written by Pumpkin and are not running-server captures.
Map 0 contains pixels 231/17, a bold Home red banner at (10,64,-10), and frame
entity 73 at (-12,64,14), rotation 90. The last allocated ID is 4.

frame-detach.dat is a literal, independently hand-encoded 26.3 map NBT fixture
(not Pumpkin output or an in-game capture). It contains colors 231/17, a bold
Home red banner, a previous-process frame 73 at (8,65,9), another frame 74 at
(12,65,10), and unknown root, map and frame fields for preservation checks.
